claim_decisions.statement: FAO's August 2026 brief places about 45% of the nationally estimated June–August CH Phase 3 population in Savanes. It separately reports insecurity-related livelihood/trade disruption and about 13,400 IDPs as of June.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: 45% is a share of the national CH3 caseload, not the proportion of Savanes residents. June–August estimates and June displacement are historical, not October stocks.

gaps: Savanes insecurity and seasonal weather stress are both documented but not attributed to one another. Historical 2024 IED-related access restrictions are not current October route conditions.
UNICEF climate-landscape claims use its direct national publisher summary, not inaccessible full-report results.

executive_assessment.text: Kara/Savanes planting stress and Greater Lomé/Maritime/Plateaux flooding give dated subnational climate evidence; Savanes food-security concentration is not a local prevalence rate.
Named prefecture access restrictions and displacement-related service gaps deepen FCV context, while national warning and child-policy material describes capacity and remaining gaps.
